_comment: graphBuilder's command surface as DATA (deep review 2026-11-21, Build 2, F-38). actionList: every action switch, in help order; graphBuilder.js runs actions[switchName], and test-operatorInput.js holds this list, the actions module's exports and the help SYNOPSIS/COMMANDS to each other both ways. helpSwitchNameList: the switches that print help and exit 0 before anything else is read. modifierSwitchNameList: the switches that are not actions (qtools-x-log reads them from process.argv). bareSwitchFlagNameList: the --flags documented as usable with no value (--name[=<value>]); bare, one is admitted only as the LAST token, because the parser hands a bare flag the next token as its value. Every other --flag must be typed --name=<value>. singleValueFlagNameSuffixList: a flag whose name ends with one of these names ONE path, so a comma in it (which the parser splits into two values) is refused rather than half-read.
